  st_as_sf(coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(eqdc)








usa_border <- states |>
  st_union() |> 
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities <- cities |>
  mutate(
    dist_to_usa_border = st_distance(cities, usa_border),
    dist_to_usa_border = set_units(dist_to_usa_border, "km"),
    dist_to_usa_border = drop_units(dist_to_usa_border)
  )

farthest_from_usa <- cities |>
  select(city, state_name, dist_to_usa_border) |>
  arrange(desc(dist_to_usa_border)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)

states_all <- USAboundaries::us_states(resolution = "low") |>
  filter(!state_abbr %in% c("PR")) |>  
  st_transform(eqdc)

usa_border_all <- states_all |>
  st_union() |> 
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities_all <- read_csv("data/uscities.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(eqdc) |>
  mutate(
    dist_to_usa_border = st_distance(geometry, usa_border_all),
    dist_to_usa_border = set_units(dist_to_usa_border, "km"),
    dist_to_usa_border = drop_units(dist_to_usa_border)
  )

border_zone_cities_all <- cities_all |>
  filter(dist_to_usa_border <= 160)

most_populous_by_state_all <- border_zone_cities_all |>
  group_by(state_name) |>
  slice_max(population, n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
